record.question: Which amongst the following is not covered under 'defence of privilege'?
options: A publication of a speech containing defamatory matters made in Parliament at the instance of the maker.
A malicious statement made in a judicial proceeding by a witness without any justification or excuse.
A confidential communication between solicitor and client.
A complaint made by a constituent to a Minister to bring to his notice the improper conduct of a public official.
